doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Algiers places, ball games and Frankie Duson
title: Elmira Pleasure Ground, the Perseverance and the Silver Leaf platforms
summary: Tom places the white Elmira Pleasure Ground on Elmira Street, with Sunday-night pictures and a brass band. Martin adds the Perseverance and Silver Leaf dancing platforms near Belvin and Lamar, where a pumping station now stands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: We'll ask and I'll go over there sometime and ask around there. Somebody will know that. Where was the Elmira Pleasure Ground? Fess told us about that, but he didn't seem... The Elmira Pleasure Ground. Yeah, Elmira Pleasure Ground.
That's the White.
Must have been right in Cramas. You don't remember.
Right in Cramas, Elmira Pleasure Ground. That's at Cramas. That's right. Yeah, that was White. Yeah, that was on Elmira Street down there. Elmira Street. Yeah, that was White.
Would it be near Elmira then or what other street I don't know? It was on Elmira.
No, that's on Elmira. Yes. Cramas used to be right at the corner of...
I see it's Belvin then Elmira. Belvin then Elmira. Yeah, that's where all... Belvin then Elmira.
Used to give pictures there every Sunday night. It was the Whites then. Yeah, it was the Whites then. I guess some of the...

The Fests some of them might have played there I guess. Some others... Well, they had a White band or a Brass band. Used to have a Brass band play there. Yeah, they played there every Sunday night. No, they were there. I was there...
Where the... The... Well, that's on the front there. Padgett Street. Right down by the river.
Near the police station was that...
Fast Showbasket, yeah. That's what I did. What was that called though?
All them circus used to come out of the name.
Have any name? Was it a park?
No, it didn't have no park. It just said it was a green we called it. Like South America.
Yeah. Vest showed me that one day. He mentioned something about, I believe, was it Perseverance?
Perseverance, that's what's back there, Belvin and Lamar.
Someplace where, I think he said there's a pumping station or water. That's right.

Is that it? That's right. The pumping station, when they put the pumping station back there, there are two of them back there. The Silver Lease and the Perseverance. What was the other? You remember them two? There wasn't no halls. There was a platform. Flatform, but they used to give dances, picnics.
What was the one? Perseverance and the other was? Silver Lease. Silver Lease. That's right.
Back there. Back there, Elmira, Belvin and Pacific and right where the pumping station that day, where the baseball park there, right on that spot of land.
